headline: Vallourec (ENXTPA:VK) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Split On Outlook
summary: Vallourec’s analyst fair value mark has been trimmed from €27.39 to €26.52, highlighting a small reset in what some models see as a central price target area for the stock. Recent research has shown a more mixed tone, with some analysts lifting targets and others moving down toward the €22.30 range as they weigh execution risk and valuation differently. As you read on, you will see how these shifting targets fit into the broader Vallourec story and what to watch as the narrative...

headline: Morgan Stanley (MS) Faces Questions After Mortgage Pressure Allegations Surface
summary: Allegations have surfaced that Morgan Stanley bankers were pressured to approve mortgages for wealthy clients. The claims focus on internal conduct and risk controls within the wealth management business. Regulators and investors are assessing potential implications for NYSE:MS and its governance practices. headline: US Treasury intervenes to support yen through purchases - FT
summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Treasury intervened in currency markets on Friday by purchasing yen, joining Japan’s efforts to support the currency from near four-decade lows, the Financial Times reported.

headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Morgan Stanley (MS) Balancing New Debt Issuance With a US$1.15 Dividend
summary: Morgan Stanley recently completed several fixed-income offerings totaling about US$53.27 million, issued a series of senior unsecured fixed-rate notes maturing between 2027 and 2033, and confirmed a total dividend of US$1.15 per share with an ex-dividend date of 31 July 2026.
